When clicking the print icon for a Sales Invoice, is there a way to have which Print Format is selected based off some code? Right now it appears to be using the last value used. I was thinking I could use the before_print hook but it doesn’t seem to do anything. This is what I had tried:

In hooks.py:

doc_events = {
    "Sales Invoice": {
        "before_print": "customapp.extensions.sales_invoice.before_print"
    }
}

In then in my sales_invoice.py file:

import frappe

def before_print( doc, settings=None, method=None ):
    if doc.company == "Company 1":
        doc.print_format = "Company 1 Sales Invoice"
    else:
        doc.print_format = "Default Sales Invoice"

Has anyone accomplished something like this?
